jobs.description:
We're Searching for Our Next Chief Operating Officer

Not simply to manage a law firm. But to help continue building one of the most innovative family law firms in the country.

Laughlin Legal, PC represents founders, venture capital professionals, technology executives, entrepreneurs, physicians, professional athletes, and other sophisticated clients throughout Silicon Valley and California. Our matters frequently involve complex financial issues, executive compensation, founder equity, private equity, closely held businesses, international issues, and high-conflict custody litigation.

Over the past thirteen years, we have built one of California's fastest-growing family law firms. Our gross revenue has increased by approximately 25% to 50% year over year for thirteen consecutive years.

Why? Because we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence. We strive to provide the highest level of legal representation and client service in family law in California. We invest in exceptional people, embrace innovation, continually refine our systems, and refuse to become complacent. We believe that when you build an extraordinary team and deliver an extraordinary client experience, sustained growth naturally follows.

Just as importantly, we believe extraordinary results should never come at the expense of extraordinary people.

We have intentionally built a collaborative, collegial culture where people genuinely enjoy working together, support one another, and are committed to each other's success. We value excellence, but we also value balance. Unlike many firms, our attorneys are expected to bill only 1,400 hours per year, allowing them to spend meaningful time with their families, pursue personal interests, and build fulfilling lives outside the office.

We reject the notion that burnout is the price of success. Our experience has proven otherwise. By investing in exceptional people, creating outstanding systems, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture people are proud to be part of, we have achieved remarkable growth while maintaining a workplace where talented professionals choose to build long-term careers.

This is a true executive leadership position. You will serve as my strategic partner in shaping the future of the firm while leading our operations, people, technology, and long-term growth. You will have a meaningful voice in the future direction of the firm and the opportunity to help build an organization that sets a new standard for family law.

Key Responsibilites:
Executive leadership and strategic planning
Recruiting, retaining, and developing exceptional attorneys and professional staff
Associate coaching, mentoring, leadership development, and performance management
Elevating every aspect of the client experience
Optimizing Clio and leveraging its full capabilities across the firm
Designing scalable systems, workflows, and operational excellence
Leading the implementation of artificial intelligence and automation throughout the firm
Coordinating marketing and business development initiatives
Financial management, budgeting, billing, collections, profitability, and key performance metrics
Developing and implementing strategic growth and expansion initiatives
Helping design the firm's future leadership and partnership structure

The Ideal Candidate Will Have:
Significant executive leadership experience within a successful law firm for a minimum of 5 years
Demonstrated success building high-performing teams and scalable operations
Extensive experience with Clio (Clio Certified Consultant or Clio Partner experience is strongly preferred)
Exceptional financial, operational, and business acumen
Experience implementing technology and AI solutions to improve efficiency and client service
Outstanding emotional intelligence, leadership, judgment, and communication skills
An entrepreneurial mindset with an unwavering commitment to excellence
A passion for building organizations, developing people, and creating a culture where others thrive
Excellent references and longevity in employment

We are building more than a successful law firm.

We are building a place where exceptional professionals can do the best work of their careers without sacrificing the people and experiences that matter most. We believe a law firm can be both extraordinarily successful and deeply human. We believe innovation, kindness, accountability, and excellence can coexist. After thirteen years of sustained growth, we have demonstrated that they do.

If our next chapter excites you, we'd love to meet you.

Compensation
Base salary: $260,000–$300,000, depending on experience
Performance bonus
Comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401-k, life insurance)
3 weeks’ vacation
13 paid holidays
Sick leave

Please send your résumé and a cover letter explaining why this opportunity speaks to you to careers@laughlinlegal.com

Great law firms are not built by great lawyers alone.

They are built by visionary leaders who know how to attract exceptional people, create extraordinary systems, embrace innovation, and build organizations that endure.

If you're excited by the opportunity to help build one of the premier family law firms in the nation, we'd love to hear from you! Amy Laughlin

jobs.description:
Organization:
Bleeding Disorders Association of Northeastern New York (BDANENY)
Location:
Albany/Troy/Capital Region, NY (Hybrid / Flexible remote options available)
Position Type:
Full-Time, Exempt
Reports To:
Board of Directors

About Us

The Bleeding Disorders Association of Northeastern New York (BDANENY) is a dedicated non-profit organization serving individuals and families affected by hemophilia, von Willebrand disease, and other rare bleeding disorders. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for our community through advocacy, education, support, and research funding. We provide a vital network of resources and a compassionate community for those navigating these lifelong conditions.
Position Summary

BDANENY is seeking a versatile, strategic, and hands-on Executive Director (ED)
to lead our chapter. As the chief executive officer, you will wear many hats—acting as both the strategic visionary and the operational anchor for the organization. You will oversee everything from high-level advocacy and coalition building to day-to-day office administration, financial oversight, fundraising, and member support.
The ideal candidate is an empathetic leader with a sharp business mind, a passion for healthcare advocacy, and the ability to comfortably pivot between community engagement and rigorous non-profit compliance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Office Administration & Financial Oversight

Daily Operations:
Manage tech infrastructure, equipment, supplies, and database maintenance (Bloomerang). Oversee essential apps and programs (Zoom, Microsoft Office, MailChimp, Namecheap, etc.).
Financial Management:
Handle payroll, bill paying, and meticulous budgeting.
Compliance & Banking:
Provide oversight for banking and financial services (Key Bank, credit card processing). Ensure full compliance with the IRS, NYS, and the NYS Charities Bureau.
Insurance & HR Risk:
Manage Workers' Compensation, disability, and Directors and Officers (D&O) insurance policies.

2. Fundraising & Development

Event Planning:
Direct major annual fundraising initiatives, most notably the signature BDANENY Walk.
Grant Management:
Write, submit, and report on organizational and program-specific grants.
Vendor & Corporate Relations:
Manage industry vendor relationships, including pharmaceutical and specialty pharmacy portals and formal letters of request.

3. Advocacy & Policy Tracking

Coalition & Government Relations:
Represent BDANENY in the NYS Bleeding Disorders Coalition; meet with government officials, write advocacy letters, and champion bills of interest.
Policy Monitoring:
Stay current on federal and state policies, programs, and pending legislation (including CDC, NIH, CMS, SSA, and Medicaid).
Care Barrier Identification:
Actively identify and address impediments to patient care, including inpatient issues, Medicare/Medicaid hurdles, and commercial insurance barriers.

4. Member Support & Community Education

Direct Aid Programs:
Oversee the administration of member support initiatives, including BDA Grants, emergency funds, travel reimbursements, scholarships, and MedicAlert bracelets.
Educational Programming:
Plan and execute sponsored dinners, webinars, and the BDANENY Annual Meeting.

5. Marketing, Communications & Design

Digital Presence:
Maintain the organization's website, including technical backend tasks (domains, SSL certificates, and Cloudflare).
Public Relations:
Drive community engagement via Facebook, MailChimp newsletters, and internal graphic design needs for promotional materials.

6. Coalition Building & Meetings Management

Strategic Partnerships:
Foster vital relationships with regional and national partners, including but not limited to Medicaid Matters, the Chapter & Staff Organization (CSO), HFA, NBDF, the Red Cross, Rensselaer County Chamber of Commerce, Troy BID, Stewart’s, Double H Ranch, and Sickle Cell/other disease state associations.
Stakeholder Meetings:
Manage communications and logistics for the Board of Directors, organizational committees, Hemophilia Treatment Centers (HTCs), and corporate vendors.

Qualifications

Experience:
5+ years of progressive leadership experience in non-profit management, healthcare administration, or a relevant sector preferred.
Technical & Financial Acumen:
Proven experience managing payroll, budgets, NYS compliance (Charities Bureau), and fundamental IT/database systems (Bloomerang, MailChimp, Cloudflare/web domains).
Advocacy & Healthcare Knowledge:
Strong understanding of New York State legislative processes, Medicaid, and the healthcare barriers facing rare disease communities.
Fundraising Prowess:
Demonstrated success in grant writing, event logistics (Walks), and corporate vendor relations.
Design & Communication:
Basic graphic design capability and excellent written communication skills for newsletters, letter-writing campaigns, and digital media.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Business, Public Administration, Public Health, Non-Profit Management) preferred.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary:
$60,000 - $70,000
Benefits:
$2,500 per year towards an Individual Health Insurance plan
Work Environment:
Hybrid remote/office schedule, includes attendance to events out of office hours based out of the Capital Region (Albany/Troy area).

To Apply

Interested candidates should submit a thoughtful cover letter
detailing their alignment with our mission and operational needs, along with a current resume
to memberservices@bdaneny.org with the subject line "Executive Director Application – [Your Name]".
BDANENY is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and community members.

jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

Company:
 The Simulation Lab (TSL)
Role: 
Partner to the Founder & CEO — the number two seat
Reports to:
Founder & CEO, directly and solely
Location:
Expected HQ in Florida, with significant work in TN, TX, CA, and other markets (both domestically and internationally)
Commitment  
Full-time · long-horizon · all-in · substantial time alongside our Founder & CEO

HOW WE OPERATE

They said it would take years:

4 days + 15 hours.
An American shipyard launched a 441-foot Liberty ship that fast in 1942, from the moment its keel was laid.
410 days.
The Empire State Building, 1931. Roughly 4.5 floors a week.
19 days.
A 57-story tower in Changsha, 2015.
19 days.
A 100,000-GPU supercomputing cluster brought online by xAI in 2024.

They said nothing could be built at that scale:

Every 63 minutes.
A complete four-engine B-24 bomber off the line at Willow Run in 1944 — from a country that built roughly 2,000 military aircraft in all of 1939, and 96,000 in 1944 alone.
8 years.
From a country with 15 minutes of total human spaceflight experience committing to the Moon, to a man walking on it.
40 years.
A fishing village of 30,000 people became Shenzhen, a city of more than 17 million.

They said it would always cost what it cost:

$2.7B to a few hundred dollars.
The first human genome took 13 years and $2.7B to sequence. It now takes a day.
More than 20-fold.
The drop in the cost of putting a kilogram into orbit, because one company decided rockets should be reusable.
More than 99%.
The decline in the cost of solar power since the 1970s.

Every one was called impossible, unrealistic, or reckless by people certain they knew how long things take and what they cost. Every one was wrong — not because the physics changed, but because someone refused to accept the timeline and the price tag, and proved they were never real.

That is the entire thesis of The Simulation Lab, applied to manufacturing world-class assets, teams, and companies at scale. Our Founder & CEO is looking for one person to help accelerate it.

WHAT TSL IS

TSL is an AI-powered value-creation factory. We do not invest in companies — we manufacture them: world-class assets, teams, and companies built to institutional grade via a proven value-creation system, not intuition or prediction.

TSL is organized as 14 operating arms beneath a single sovereign parent — each a market category building and scaling its own portfolio companies, all running in parallel with first-principles reasoning and execution speed most organizations consider fictional or impossible.

TSL Innovation.
The frontier engine — originating and pressure-testing opportunities before a market is obvious or a thesis is consensus.
TSL Intelligence.
The AI engine and foundational layer of the next economy. Whoever controls the intelligence layer controls everything built on it.
TSL Technologies.
Software, platforms, and hard tech — enterprise software, developer tools, connected systems, cybersecurity, and compute.
TSL Services.
The capital-formation and professional-services platforms every company needs — capital placement, legal, consulting, financial advisory, human capital, marketing.
TSL Entertainment.
The full entertainment value chain — content and production studios, film and TV, digital media, publishing, streaming, and live experiences.
TSL Commerce.
The everyday economy — retail and e-commerce, food and beverage, education, recreation, hospitality, luxury goods, and consumer finance.
TSL Ventures.
Joint ventures, co-builds, and strategic partnerships — the factory’s system applied to opportunities originating outside it.
TSL Capital.
The investment arm — venture, private equity, hedge-fund and quant strategies, private credit, and institutional asset management.
TSL Real Estate.
Physical assets — flagship innovation campuses and corporate resorts, master-planned mega-developments, land aggregation, modular construction, and commercial and hospitality properties.
TSL Infrastructure.
Large-scale systems the economy depends on — energy and power, transportation and logistics, agriculture, advanced manufacturing, and utilities.
TSL Public Sector.
Government and national priorities — federal contracting, national security, defense and aerospace, public health, and public-private programs.
TSL Health.
The health, wellness, and longevity economy — digital health, preventative medicine, biotech, medical devices, human performance, and health data.
TSL Sports.
Franchises and league investments, media and broadcasting rights, athlete representation, sports tech, stadium development, and fan experiences.
TSL Foundation.
Where the factory’s output serves purpose beyond return — philanthropy, social-impact investment, and community development.

The target: 50–250 proprietary builds and $1T+ in value created within 5 years...and that is just the beginning.

THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY

Partner to the Founder & CEO.
The #2 at TSL — and proud of it. His right hand on everything.

You are not supporting the work. You are doing it, next to him, with your own authority and mandate.

When TSL raises capital, you raise it with him. When TSL needs a world-class team, you recruit it with him. When TSL enters a segment neither of you has operated in, you build it with him. When something is broken, you own it until it is not.

There is no such thing as "out of scope." There is only what has to get done. Period.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Capital Formation.
Engaging and closing capital partners across the stack — FOs, VCs, PE Firms, private credit, institutions, and SWFs— on timelines that should not be possible.
Talent.
Sourcing and closing the top 1% of builders, operators, and domain experts, faster than the market can react.
PC Builds.
Taking a build from architecture to activation to scale, owning the outcome.
Strategy & Game Theory.
Thinking several moves ahead of the market, the competition, and the counterparty.
Problem Elimination.
Finding the obstacle before it becomes a problem and removing it before it costs a day.
Focus Protection.
Guarding our Founder & CEO's time and attention ruthlessly, so only the highest-leverage work reaches him.

WHO OUR FOUNDER & CEO IS LOOKING FOR

You feel unfinished work physically.
A day without progress registers as a loss, and bothers you long after everyone else has moved on.
You move fast enough to make people uncomfortable.
Not busy — fast. There is a difference, and you have spent your career on the right side.
You are a delusional optimist who reasons from first principles.
You have been told your plan was impossible often enough that the word stopped landing, and you do not accept a constraint until you take it apart yourself.
Your network answers.
Not a contact list — a living network. When we need capital, you reach FOs, VCs, PE Firms, credit, and SWFs directly. When we need someone, you call and they pick up. Zero degrees of separation.
You have done this where failure was expensive
— for a founder, principal, family office, or institution where the margin for error was zero.
You do not break. It gets hard constantly.
You find a way or make one, without theater or being managed.
You cannot tolerate mediocrity or inefficiency.
Not as a personality trait — as a standard you enforce on yourself first.
You want to be the #2.
Not from a lack of ambition, but because the most powerful seat in any organization is the one that makes the first unstoppable.

WHAT YOU BRING

A track record as a right hand, chief of staff, or senior operator to a world-class founder, CEO, principal, family office, etc. — where the stakes were real.
Direct capital-formation experience and the proven ability to move real money quickly.
Elite recruiting instincts and the ability to close exceptional people in competitive markets.
The capacity to run many high-stakes workstreams at once, without drift or being asked twice.
Communication sharp enough to represent TSL in any room, at any level, without briefing notes.
The judgment to read a room and protect the position without creating friction.
Absolute discretion. What happens inside TSL stays inside TSL. Always.

WHAT THIS IS NOT

This is not a 9-5, or a role for someone who needs perfect structure, gentle feedback, or credit distributed evenly. There are no politics here because there is no time for them.

We are pre-capitalization.
The raise is live, and closing it is one of the first things you will help with. If you need a fully funded balance sheet before you take action, this is not for you.

This will be relentless and demanding, but extremely rewarding and lucrative (when executed).

WHAT YOU GET

Base compensation
on a sliding scale that begins at the first capitalization milestone and steps up as capital is funded and wired — scaling to $1.5M as the capital stack closes.. Your pay tracks the one thing you are here to do.
Performance incentives
tied to the capital you help close and the companies we build.
A Value Participation Right (VPR)
. TSL does not issue equity — not to investors, not to executives, not to anyone. Instead we grant a contractual, dollar-denominated participation in the realized value of everything TSL builds, on a long-term vesting schedule. Your target is a floor, not a ceiling...and it compounds across every asset, team, and company TSL ever manufactures.

The package is defined and committed. It is not a range to negotiate later — it goes to whoever steps in and executes.

HOW TO APPLY

Do not just send a résumé. Stand out by sending/sharing meaningful things, like:

The hardest thing(s) you have ever gotten done.
What it was, what stood in the way, and how long it took.
Three calls you could make this week
that would move a 9-figure raise. Names optional. Institutions are not.
What you would own in your first 30 days here
— specifically.

Mark this opportunity as your top choice and tell us why you are the right-hand partner our Founder & CEO is looking for. If what you send is strong, you will hear from him directly, and quickly.

The future belongs to those who build it, not those who wait for it.

*The magic number is 8*

OVERVIEW

Company:
 The Simulation Lab (TSL)
Role: 
Partner to the Founder & CEO — the number two seat
Reports to:
Founder & CEO, directly and solely
Location:
Expected HQ in Florida, with significant work in TN, TX, CA, and other markets (both domestically and internationally)
Commitment  
Full-time · long-horizon · all-in · substantial time alongside our Founder & CEO

HOW WE OPERATE

They said it would take years:

4 days + 15 hours.
An American shipyard launched a 441-foot Liberty ship that fast in 1942, from the moment its keel was laid.
410 days.
The Empire State Building, 1931. Roughly 4.5 floors a week.
19 days.
A 57-story tower in Changsha, 2015.
19 days.
A 100,000-GPU supercomputing cluster brought online by xAI in 2024.

They said nothing could be built at that scale:

Every 63 minutes.
A complete four-engine B-24 bomber off the line at Willow Run in 1944 — from a country that built roughly 2,000 military aircraft in all of 1939, and 96,000 in 1944 alone.
8 years.
From a country with 15 minutes of total human spaceflight experience committing to the Moon, to a man walking on it.
40 years.
A fishing village of 30,000 people became Shenzhen, a city of more than 17 million.

They said it would always cost what it cost:

$2.7B to a few hundred dollars.
The first human genome took 13 years and $2.7B to sequence. It now takes a day.
More than 20-fold.
The drop in the cost of putting a kilogram into orbit, because one company decided rockets should be reusable.
More than 99%.
The decline in the cost of solar power since the 1970s.

Every one was called impossible, unrealistic, or reckless by people certain they knew how long things take and what they cost. Every one was wrong — not because the physics changed, but because someone refused to accept the timeline and the price tag, and proved they were never real.

That is the entire thesis of The Simulation Lab, applied to manufacturing world-class assets, teams, and companies at scale. Our Founder & CEO is looking for one person to help accelerate it.

WHAT TSL IS

TSL is an AI-powered value-creation factory. We do not invest in companies — we manufacture them: world-class assets, teams, and companies built to institutional grade via a proven value-creation system, not intuition or prediction.

TSL is organized as 14 operating arms beneath a single sovereign parent — each a market category building and scaling its own portfolio companies, all running in parallel with first-principles reasoning and execution speed most organizations consider fictional or impossible.

TSL Innovation.
The frontier engine — originating and pressure-testing opportunities before a market is obvious or a thesis is consensus.
TSL Intelligence.
The AI engine and foundational layer of the next economy. Whoever controls the intelligence layer controls everything built on it.
TSL Technologies.
Software, platforms, and hard tech — enterprise software, developer tools, connected systems, cybersecurity, and compute.
TSL Services.
The capital-formation and professional-services platforms every company needs — capital placement, legal, consulting, financial advisory, human capital, marketing.
TSL Entertainment.
The full entertainment value chain — content and production studios, film and TV, digital media, publishing, streaming, and live experiences.
TSL Commerce.
The everyday economy — retail and e-commerce, food and beverage, education, recreation, hospitality, luxury goods, and consumer finance.
TSL Ventures.
Joint ventures, co-builds, and strategic partnerships — the factory’s system applied to opportunities originating outside it.
TSL Capital.
The investment arm — venture, private equity, hedge-fund and quant strategies, private credit, and institutional asset management.
TSL Real Estate.
Physical assets — flagship innovation campuses and corporate resorts, master-planned mega-developments, land aggregation, modular construction, and commercial and hospitality properties.
TSL Infrastructure.
Large-scale systems the economy depends on — energy and power, transportation and logistics, agriculture, advanced manufacturing, and utilities.
TSL Public Sector.
Government and national priorities — federal contracting, national security, defense and aerospace, public health, and public-private programs.
TSL Health.
The health, wellness, and longevity economy — digital health, preventative medicine, biotech, medical devices, human performance, and health data.
TSL Sports.
Franchises and league investments, media and broadcasting rights, athlete representation, sports tech, stadium development, and fan experiences.
TSL Foundation.
Where the factory’s output serves purpose beyond return — philanthropy, social-impact investment, and community development.

The target: 50–250 proprietary builds and $1T+ in value created within 5 years...and that is just the beginning.

THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY

Partner to the Founder & CEO.
The #2 at TSL — and proud of it. His right hand on everything.

You are not supporting the work. You are doing it, next to him, with your own authority and mandate.

When TSL raises capital, you raise it with him. When TSL needs a world-class team, you recruit it with him. When TSL enters a segment neither of you has operated in, you build it with him. When something is broken, you own it until it is not.

There is no such thing as "out of scope." There is only what has to get done. Period.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Capital Formation.
Engaging and closing capital partners across the stack — FOs, VCs, PE Firms, private credit, institutions, and SWFs— on timelines that should not be possible.
Talent.
Sourcing and closing the top 1% of builders, operators, and domain experts, faster than the market can react.
PC Builds.
Taking a build from architecture to activation to scale, owning the outcome.
Strategy & Game Theory.
Thinking several moves ahead of the market, the competition, and the counterparty.
Problem Elimination.
Finding the obstacle before it becomes a problem and removing it before it costs a day.
Focus Protection.
Guarding our Founder & CEO's time and attention ruthlessly, so only the highest-leverage work reaches him.

WHO OUR FOUNDER & CEO IS LOOKING FOR

You feel unfinished work physically.
A day without progress registers as a loss, and bothers you long after everyone else has moved on.
You move fast enough to make people uncomfortable.
Not busy — fast. There is a difference, and you have spent your career on the right side.
You are a delusional optimist who reasons from first principles.
You have been told your plan was impossible often enough that the word stopped landing, and you do not accept a constraint until you take it apart yourself.
Your network answers.
Not a contact list — a living network. When we need capital, you reach FOs, VCs, PE Firms, credit, and SWFs directly. When we need someone, you call and they pick up. Zero degrees of separation.
You have done this where failure was expensive
— for a founder, principal, family office, or institution where the margin for error was zero.
You do not break. It gets hard constantly.
You find a way or make one, without theater or being managed.
You cannot tolerate mediocrity or inefficiency.
Not as a personality trait — as a standard you enforce on yourself first.
You want to be the #2.
Not from a lack of ambition, but because the most powerful seat in any organization is the one that makes the first unstoppable.

WHAT YOU BRING

A track record as a right hand, chief of staff, or senior operator to a world-class founder, CEO, principal, family office, etc. — where the stakes were real.
Direct capital-formation experience and the proven ability to move real money quickly.
Elite recruiting instincts and the ability to close exceptional people in competitive markets.
The capacity to run many high-stakes workstreams at once, without drift or being asked twice.
Communication sharp enough to represent TSL in any room, at any level, without briefing notes.
The judgment to read a room and protect the position without creating friction.
Absolute discretion. What happens inside TSL stays inside TSL. Always.

WHAT THIS IS NOT

This is not a 9-5, or a role for someone who needs perfect structure, gentle feedback, or credit distributed evenly. There are no politics here because there is no time for them.

We are pre-capitalization.
The raise is live, and closing it is one of the first things you will help with. If you need a fully funded balance sheet before you take action, this is not for you.

This will be relentless and demanding, but extremely rewarding and lucrative (when executed).

WHAT YOU GET

Base compensation
on a sliding scale that begins at the first capitalization milestone and steps up as capital is funded and wired — scaling to $1.5M as the capital stack closes.. Your pay tracks the one thing you are here to do.
Performance incentives
tied to the capital you help close and the companies we build.
A Value Participation Right (VPR)
. TSL does not issue equity — not to investors, not to executives, not to anyone. Instead we grant a contractual, dollar-denominated participation in the realized value of everything TSL builds, on a long-term vesting schedule. Your target is a floor, not a ceiling...and it compounds across every asset, team, and company TSL ever manufactures.

The package is defined and committed. It is not a range to negotiate later — it goes to whoever steps in and executes.

HOW TO APPLY

Do not just send a résumé. Stand out by sending/sharing meaningful things, like:

The hardest thing(s) you have ever gotten done.
What it was, what stood in the way, and how long it took.
Three calls you could make this week
that would move a 9-figure raise. Names optional. Institutions are not.
What you would own in your first 30 days here
— specifically.

Mark this opportunity as your top choice and tell us why you are the right-hand partner our Founder & CEO is looking for. If what you send is strong, you will hear from him directly, and quickly.

The future belongs to those who build it, not those who wait for it.

*The magic number is 8*
